description: This file defines an API router for handling input submission requests in a FastAPI application. It provides an endpoint for users to submit a Wikipedia page URL or topic name for extraction, queues the job, and returns a status response.

classes.name: InputSubmission
classes.description: Model representing the input data submitted for extraction, including the type and value.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response status of a submitted job, including job ID, status, and progress.

methods.name: StatusResponse submit_input( payload: InputSubmission, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, subject: str = Depends(get_current_subject), )
methods.description: API endpoint to submit an extraction job, queues the job, and returns a status response.

ctags.name: submit_input
ctags.signature: ( payload: InputSubmission, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, subject: str = Depends(get_current_subject), )
